properties.description: Annual mosaics of the GLACE composites for 2025, on a fixed equal-area grid (ETRS89-LAEA, 40 m) every year of this collection shares.

links.title: CEOS-ARD PFS for Synthetic Aperture Radar v1.3.1

coh12_vh.title: Coherence VH
coh12_vh.description: 12-day repeat-pass interferometric coherence, cross-polarized (VH), resampled from the 10 m tiles onto the 40 m equal-area grid by averaging in the linear domain. Dimensionless, in [0, 1].

coh12_vh_qa_cqm.title: Coherence VH – Composite Quality Map
coh12_vh_qa_cqm.description: Composite quality of the Coherence VH composite: the local resolution of the weighted composite, where higher is better resolved, averaged onto the 40 m grid. Linear scaling; the decibel conversion is declared in the collection's renders.

coh12_vh_qa_cqm_viz.title: Coherence VH – Composite Quality Map – PMTiles
coh12_vh_qa_cqm_viz.description: Value-encoded WebP tiles of Coherence VH – Composite Quality Map on WebMercatorQuad z5-z13: an 8-bit code in all three channels, linear over -13 to 19 dB and clipped to it, with code 0 as nodata. Decode with the band's raster:scale and raster:offset; the year's style decodes it as a raster-dem source and colours it with a color-relief layer. Lossy (WebP quality 90): for analysis, read the COGs with the "data" role.

coh12_vh_qa_num.title: Coherence VH – Contributing Observations
coh12_vh_qa_num.description: Mean number of acquisitions that contributed to the Coherence VH composite, averaged over the 10 m pixels inside each 40 m pixel: a float mean of the counts.
